programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.desc: Rick takes a trip down the rabbit hole after a seller hops in with a first edition of 'Alice's Adventures in Wonderland.' Can it make Rick grin like the Cheshire Cat, or drive him mad.

programs.title: The Toys That Built The World
programs.desc: In 1983, underdog company Tonka sets out to bring a game-changing toy from Japan to America: the transformable robot. But they're soon confronted by industry giant, Hasbro, who has its own competing line.

programs.title: The Food That Built The World
programs.desc: An upstart named Oscar Mayer creates one of the most iconic meat brands on the planet. While Jay Hormel invents a meat product sold the world over, which becomes part of a 20-billion-dollar food empire.

programs.title: The Unbelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programs.desc: From riding tree trunks down a slope to hosting a barrage of monkeys for an all-you-can-eat buffet to a food fight of epic proportions. These are the stories of history's most extraordinary traditions.

programs.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programs.desc: For millennia, there has been speculation about how the world will end. From the detailed account in the Book of Revelation to the prophecies foretold by Nostradamus. Could any of these come true.

programs.title: The Pickers
programs.desc: Mike and Jersey go hog wild for a four-generation carny collection complete with carousel horses, toy tanks, and bumper cars. Down the road in New Hampshire, the guys head to Roger's analogue laboratory.
